301	**Why sheafifying is what makes an unconditional statement possible.** The
302	unsheafified functor `picSharp C = T ↦ Pic(C ×_k T)/π_T^* Pic(T)` is *not*
303	representable over a general field — it is not even a Zariski sheaf (Kleiman §2
304	L1292–L1302), and a representable functor is a sheaf for any subcanonical
305	topology. So an unconditional `RepresentableBy` against `picSharp` would be a
306	FALSE statement, not merely an unproved one. Against `picEt` it is Kleiman's own
307	theorem. `PicScheme.picEt_isSheaf_forget` records the sheaf property that makes
308	the difference, and it is proved rather than assumed.
309	
310	**Expected to stay open, and that is the honest state rather than a defect.**
311	Discharging it means formalising the Kleiman §4 existence proof: the Abel-map
312	slice `Div^d_{C/k} → Pic^d_{C/k}` is a smooth proper equivalence relation whose
313	quotient is a scheme (`smoothProperQuotient`, itself gated on
314	`HasSmoothProperQuotient` because Mathlib `v4.31` has no quasi-projectivity
315	vocabulary), together with `Div` representability (Kleiman §3 Thm `th:repDiv`,
316	which needs the Quot scheme). Neither input is available; the project reaches
317	this statement rather than proving it, and it is the single named `sorry` that
318	the whole Jacobian headline rests on. Do not replace it with a weaker
319	conditional statement to make a count go down.
320	
321	This is the **sole** `sorry` of the seam: everything else below — the
322	representing scheme `PicSchemeEt`, its representability, local finiteness,
323	separatedness and group-scheme structure, the comparison class
324	`PicEtComparisonIso` and the conditional `picSchemeOfHasRationalPoint` — is
325	derived from it.
326	
327	**Why the second conjunct is bundled here rather than given its own `sorry`.**
328	Clause (1) is Kleiman §4; clause (2) is Kleiman §2 Thm 2.5 (`th:comp`): given a
329	section, the comparison `picSharp C → Pic_{(C/k)ét}` is an isomorphism. Both are
330	theorems of the same paper and neither is formalised. They are stated as one
331	named obligation on purpose: the `picSharp`-shaped consumer interface
332	(`HasPicScheme`, and through it the tangent-space chain and the `k̄` Albanese
333	witness) needs clause (2) to exist at all, and splitting it out would report the
334	Jacobian headline as resting on *six* open obligations where the mathematics has
335	five. The bundling adds no strength — clause (2) is conditional on a section, so
336	it says nothing about a pointless curve — and it keeps the frontier count honest
337	in both directions. `scripts/axiom-frontier.lean` measures the result rather
338	than asserting it. -/

486	The same statement as `isAlbanese_pic0`, for the identity component of the scheme
487	representing the étale-sheafified functor — over an arbitrary base field, for every
488	`k`-rational marked point, and with **no hypothesis on `C(k)`**.
489	
490	Its content over the landed `Albanese.Pic0.albanese_universal_property` is the three
491	pieces recorded on `isAlbanese_pic0_of_isAlgClosed`: arbitrary base field in place of
492	algebraically closed (the Galois-descent step of cluster `G`), `genus C = 0` as well as
493	positive genus (Mumford §4 rigidity), and the basepoint condition `P ≫ ι_P = η`. To those
494	the étale formulation adds the same transport `isAlbanese_pic0` does not need: the landed
495	Abel–Jacobi morphism `Pic0.abelJacobi` is constructed for `Pic0Scheme`, and carrying it
496	to `Pic0SchemeEt` is part of this leaf.
497	
498	Note that the marked point `P` appears here as an argument, not as a hypothesis on `C`:
499	`IsAlbanese` is a statement *about* a pointing, and `JacobianWitness.isAlbaneseFor`
500	quantifies over all of them. That is exactly why the headline needs no rational point —
501	the witness scheme `J` is intrinsic to `C`, and only the universal morphism depends on a
502	choice of `P`, in the same way `Challenge.lean` binds a point only in
503	`AbelJacobi.Jacobian.ofCurve`. -/

505	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
506	    (grp : GrpObj (Scheme.Pic0SchemeEt C)) (pr : IsProper (Scheme.Pic0SchemeEt C).hom)
507	    (sm : Smooth (Scheme.Pic0SchemeEt C).hom)
508	    (gi : GeometricallyIrreducible (Scheme.Pic0SchemeEt C).hom)
509	    (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) :

513	/-- **Leaf C in the case the landed proof covers**, over an algebraically closed field and
514	in positive genus, with the basepoint condition as an explicit hypothesis.
515	
516	This is a theorem, and it is the honest measure of the distance between
517	`isAlbanese_pic0` and the Albanese development. The factorisation clause of `IsAlbanese`
518	-- the whole universal property -- is `Albanese.Pic0.albanese_universal_property` applied
519	directly, with no transport: `Pic0.jacobianScheme C` is `Scheme.Pic0Scheme C`, so the
520	statements match on the nose. What `isAlbanese_pic0` adds is therefore three pieces of
521	mathematics:
522	
523	1. arbitrary base field, in place of algebraically closed -- the Galois-descent step of
524	   the campaign's cluster `G`;
525	2. `genus C = 0` as well as positive genus -- where `Pic⁰_{C/k} = Spec k` and the content
526	   is Mumford §4 rigidity;
527	3. the basepoint condition `P ≫ ι_P = η`, taken here as the hypothesis `hbase`.
528	
529	There is no fourth difference. An earlier version of this docstring claimed a
530	"bookkeeping" one — that the extra `[GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]` binder here, absent
531	from the general leaf, was needed because irreducibility is "not free at the binder even
532	though it is free mathematically". That is false, and it is the kind of claim worth
533	checking rather than repeating: `instGeometricallyIrreducibleOfGeometricallyIntegral`
534	synthesises it from `[GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]` directly, so the binder is redundant

139	/-- The Albanese universal property for a pointed smooth proper curve `(C, P)`.
140	An object `J` (with abelian-variety structure) is the Albanese of `(C, P)` if it
141	receives a universal pointed morphism `C ⟶ J` sending `P` to the identity. -/
142	def IsAlbanese (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C)
143	    (J : Over (Spec (.of k)))
144	    [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] : Prop :=
145	  ∃ α : C ⟶ J, P ≫ α = η[J] ∧
146	    ∀ {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom]
147	      [Smooth A.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (_ : P ≫ f = η[A]),
148	      ∃! (g : J ⟶ A), f = α ≫ g
149	
150	namespace IsAlbanese
151	
152	noncomputable def ofCurve {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
153	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
154	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J) : C ⟶ J :=
155	  Classical.choose h
156	
157	lemma comp_ofCurve {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
158	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
159	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J) :
160	    P ≫ h.ofCurve = η[J] :=
161	  (Classical.choose_spec h).1
162	
163	lemma exists_unique_ofCurve_comp {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
164	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
165	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J)
166	    {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom] [Smooth A.hom]
167	    [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (hf : P ≫ f = η[A]) :
168	    ∃! (g : J ⟶ A), f = h.ofCurve ≫ g :=
169	  (Classical.choose_spec h).2 f hf
170	
171	/-- The Albanese object is unique up to a unique isomorphism compatible with the
172	universal morphisms. -/
173	theorem unique {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C}
174	    {J₁ J₂ : Over (Spec (.of k))}
175	    [GrpObj J₁] [IsProper J₁.hom] [Smooth J₁.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J₁.hom]
176	    [GrpObj J₂] [IsProper J₂.hom] [Smooth J₂.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J₂.hom]
177	    (h₁ : IsAlbanese C P J₁) (h₂ : IsAlbanese C P J₂) :
178	    ∃! (e : J₁ ⟶ J₂), h₂.ofCurve = h₁.ofCurve ≫ e := by
179	  have ⟨g, hg_eq, hg_unique⟩ := h₁.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₂.ofCurve h₂.comp_ofCurve
180	  have ⟨h, hh_eq, hh_unique⟩ := h₂.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₁.ofCurve h₁.comp_ofCurve
181	  have ⟨g₁, hg₁_eq, hg₁_unique⟩ := h₁.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₁.ofCurve h₁.comp_ofCurve
182	  have g₁_eq_id : g₁ = 𝟙 J₁ := by
183	    refine (hg₁_unique (𝟙 J₁) ?_).symm

instance instHasPicSchemeEt {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] : HasPicSchemeEt C :=
  ⟨(fgaPicardRepresentability C).1⟩

/-- **The Picard scheme `Pic_{C/k}` over an arbitrary base field**: the scheme
representing the étale-sheafified relative Picard functor.

This is the honest `Pic_{C/k}` of the project — available for every smooth
proper geometrically integral curve, with no hypothesis on `C(k)`. The legacy
`PicScheme` (representing the unsheafified `picSharp`) exists only under a
rational point and is retained for the consumers written against it. -/
noncomputable def PicSchemeEt {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
  (HasPicSchemeEt.has_pic_scheme_et (C := C)).choose

/-- **Representability of `Pic_{(C/k)ét}` by `Pic_{C/k}`, over an arbitrary
field**: the natural bijection `(T ⟶ Pic_{C/k}) ≃ Pic_{(C/k)ét}(T)`.

The étale-formulation replacement for `PicScheme.representable`. Consumers of
the tangent-space chain should compose with *this* `homEquiv`; the `picSharp`
version is available only under `[HasRationalPoint C]`. -/
noncomputable def representableEt {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
    (PicScheme.picEt C).RepresentableBy (PicSchemeEt C) :=
  Classical.choice (HasPicSchemeEt.has_pic_scheme_et (C := C)).choose_spec.1

/-- `Pic_{C/k}` is locally of finite type over `k` (Kleiman §4 Thm `th:main`(1)),
extracted from the étale existence package. Unconditional. -/

open('GroundCheck.lean','w').write('''import AlgebraicJacobian.Jacobian
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let env := (<- getEnv).setExporting false
  let roots : List Name := [`AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian, `AlgebraicGeometry.picardJacobianWitness,
    `AlgebraicGeometry.jacobianWitness, `AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_jacobianWitness,
    `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.instGrpObj, `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.instIsProper,
    `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.instGeometricallyIrreducible,
    `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus]
  let mut seen : NameSet := {}
  let mut todo := roots
  let mut sorries : Array Name := #[]
  while !todo.isEmpty do
    match todo with
    | [] => break
    | n :: rest =>
      todo := rest
      if seen.contains n then continue
      seen := seen.insert n
      if let some ci := env.find? n then
        for c in ci.type.getUsedConstants do
          unless seen.contains c do todo := c :: todo
        if let some v := ci.value? then
          if v.getUsedConstants.contains ``sorryAx then sorries := sorries.push n
          for c in v.getUsedConstants do
            unless seen.contains c do todo := c :: todo
  logInfo m!"cone size = {seen.toList.length}"
  logInfo m!"SORRY-BODIED DECLS REACHABLE FROM HEADLINE ({sorries.size}):"
  for s in sorries do logInfo m!"  {s}"
'''.replace('<-','←'))
PY
timeout 900 lake env lean GroundCheck.lean 2>&1 | head -40

139	/-- The Albanese universal property for a pointed smooth proper curve `(C, P)`.
140	An object `J` (with abelian-variety structure) is the Albanese of `(C, P)` if it
141	receives a universal pointed morphism `C ⟶ J` sending `P` to the identity. -/
142	def IsAlbanese (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C)
143	    (J : Over (Spec (.of k)))
144	    [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] : Prop :=
145	  ∃ α : C ⟶ J, P ≫ α = η[J] ∧
146	    ∀ {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom]
147	      [Smooth A.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (_ : P ≫ f = η[A]),
148	      ∃! (g : J ⟶ A), f = α ≫ g
149	
150	namespace IsAlbanese
151	
152	noncomputable def ofCurve {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
153	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
154	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J) : C ⟶ J :=
155	  Classical.choose h
156	
157	lemma comp_ofCurve {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
158	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
159	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J) :
160	    P ≫ h.ofCurve = η[J] :=
161	  (Classical.choose_spec h).1
162	
163	lemma exists_unique_ofCurve_comp {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
164	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
165	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J)
166	    {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom] [Smooth A.hom]
167	    [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (hf : P ≫ f = η[A]) :
168	    ∃! (g : J ⟶ A), f = h.ofCurve ≫ g :=
169	  (Classical.choose_spec h).2 f hf
170	
171	/-- The Albanese object is unique up to a unique isomorphism compatible with the
172	universal morphisms. -/
173	theorem unique {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C}
174	    {J₁ J₂ : Over (Spec (.of k))}
175	    [GrpObj J₁] [IsProper J₁.hom] [Smooth J₁.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J₁.hom]
176	    [GrpObj J₂] [IsProper J₂.hom] [Smooth J₂.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J₂.hom]
177	    (h₁ : IsAlbanese C P J₁) (h₂ : IsAlbanese C P J₂) :
178	    ∃! (e : J₁ ⟶ J₂), h₂.ofCurve = h₁.ofCurve ≫ e := by
179	  have ⟨g, hg_eq, hg_unique⟩ := h₁.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₂.ofCurve h₂.comp_ofCurve
180	  have ⟨h, hh_eq, hh_unique⟩ := h₂.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₁.ofCurve h₁.comp_ofCurve
181	  have ⟨g₁, hg₁_eq, hg₁_unique⟩ := h₁.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₁.ofCurve h₁.comp_ofCurve
182	  have g₁_eq_id : g₁ = 𝟙 J₁ := by
183	    refine (hg₁_unique (𝟙 J₁) ?_).symm
